verdict.rationale: Custom reporting by dimension is a fair question for accounting software, but the evidence pack never documents building custom reports filtered or grouped by class, location, or tag. The Plus plan lists "classes" as a feature, but nothing shows class-based report filtering or grouping, and location or tag dimensions are never mentioned. The documented reports, P&L and Balance Sheet organized by Chart of Accounts plus per-entity books, are a different capability.

support.subject: As an accountant, I can build custom reports filtered and grouped by class, location, or tag dimensions
